read.thesis: Price over cost positive in Europe and NA aggregates, but NA cement pricing below expectations and cost inflation of 3-4% is not yet covered; 2026 guidance held with a wider corridor.

triggers.label: NA aggregates pricing close to inflation
triggers.quote: in aggregates, we are moving in the right direction close to inflation compensation, if not better
triggers.highlight: close to inflation compensation, if not better

triggers.label: Clinker closures in France and Germany done
triggers.quote: We have now taken the tough decisions to restructure the asset base in France and Germany. On the clinker side, and I think most of that is done.

triggers.label: NA cement margin erosion persists
triggers.quote: It's clearly not enough to cover the cost inflation, and that's why we aim to turn this around in 2027
triggers.highlight: clearly not enough to cover the cost inflation

triggers.label: 2026 guidance confirmed, corridor kept wide
triggers.quote: we are confident to deliver the guidance for 2026
triggers.highlight: confident to deliver the guidance for 2026

guidance.quote: let's stick with the corridor that we have indicated and as I said, we are confident to deliver that guidance
that should roughly be I would have said EUR30 million contribution from this in Q4
it's roughly on RCO level, it's roughly EUR130 million to EUR140 million what we know right now
with a EUR300 million additional savings program going through 2028
for '27, our view is that we have a mid- to high single-digit energy cost increase for 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are confident to deliver the guidance for 2026

prior_guidance_check.metric: Working capital to zero at year-end 2026
prior_guidance_check.quote: we want to try to get the working capital out through to zero for year-end

red_flags.label: NA cement margin erosion
red_flags.quote: that seems to be also pronounced in the industry at this point

red_flags.label: Like-for-like EBIT growth low single digit in Europe and NA
red_flags.quote: you're going to do something like low single 3%, 4% like-for-like EBIT growth

evasions.quote: we didn't feel any pressure to now change things again
we're not going to disclose anything specific other volumes more pricing
we go into the next couple of months, and then we'll decide how we proceed into 2027
